validate_aqlm_environment: validate that accelerate and aqlm packages are available before loading a quantized model
replace_model_with_aqlm_linear: replace model linear layers with AQLM quantized linear layers before weight loading
check_aqlm_trainability: check whether the installed AQLM version supports training quantized models
check_aqlm_serializability: check whether the AQLM quantizer can serialize the quantized model configuration
load_prequantized_aqlm_model: load a prequantized AQLM model by initializing the AqlmHfQuantizer with its quantization config
